metadata.title: Discovery of a parsec-scale bipolar nebula around MWC 349A

notes: No star meets the Galactic-unbound criteria. MWC 349A is discussed as a possible runaway from Cyg OB2, but the authors derive a total space velocity of only ≈20–23 km s−1 (T:p5-b4); this does not establish present-day unboundedness from the Milky Way, and cluster ejection alone is not Galactic-unbound candidacy. MWC 349B is called a "single unbound star" only in the sense that it became unbound from the dissolved triple system (T:p7-b5; T:p8-b2), not from the Milky Way. Other named stars are comparison objects and are not identified as Galactic-unbound candidates.
